selection.reason: Checkpoint 3 failed the frozen explicit-completion-before-action-32 gate. Because all checkpoints 1 through k had to qualify, neither checkpoint 4 nor any later checkpoint can produce a valid k of at least 4.

iteration_hypothesis.reason: The task does not supply three valid consecutive feedback opportunities under the matched fixed budget. More nominal checkpoints would confound recursive feedback depth with baseline action-boundary censoring.
